breaking.change: The art-bible template replaces {game} with {look}. The look's identity comes from og-project.json, not a project id, and the template no longer guesses assets/looks/<game>.ogt.
breaking.fix: The platform substitutes {look} with og-project.json look.$ogRef (for example base/looks/t7), or the literal preset name when look is a string. Stop substituting {game}; there is no game-id fallback. Resolve a physical file only through the checked project's look binding; boundary A still maps base/looks/t7 to assets/looks/t7.ogt. The engine's artBrief/create helpers do not fill artBibleTemplate.
